name: Dream Of Me
description: Clara and Luca are two teenagers who fall in love through music. She wants to be famous and so that her parents don't find out that she is participating in a contest, she calls herself Roxy-Pop. Luca is in love with Clara but doesn't know that she and Roxy-Pop are the same person.
